0.description: [Pending Restat] [Elune] [Area-52] Summoned Creatures will no longer randomize in the Manastorm.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] [Area-52] Galgann Firehammer's Fire Nova now has a 3 second cast time up from 2 seconds. It's damage has been increased by 100%.

6.description: [Pending Restart] Many green cone telegraphs in Karazhan Crypts and the Manastorm are now red to more clearly show that they are dangerous attacks which should be avoided.
[Pending Restart] [Magtheridon's Lair] [Magtheridon]: Magtheridon will now send Extra Raid Frames for his Hellfire Channelers. The 5th Channelers frame will be send when one of the others dies.
[Pending Restart] [Magtheridon's Lair] [Magtheridon]: Corrected an issue where Fel Portal's Fel Shock would not scale with certain types of damage modifiers.
[Pending Restart] [Magtheridon's Lair] [Magtheridon]: When Finger of Death jumps to another nearby target, it now increases damage flexibly, reducing as more players are in the raid.

[Pending Restart] [Magtheridon's Lair] [Magtheridon]: Fixed an issue where Finger of Death and Hand of Death would not scale with certain damage modifiers. Damage inflicted by these abilities now respects immunity effects.
[Pending Restart] [Magtheridon's Lair] [Magtheridon]: Manticron Cubes no longer increase the channelers' damage dealt upon completing the channel.

[Pending Restart] [Magtheridon's Lair] [Magtheridon]: Shadow Cage now increases Magtheridon’s damage taken by a flexible value, from 100% up to 500%, reducing as more players are present in the raid group.
[Pending Restart] [Magtheridon's Lair] [Magtheridon]: Magtheridon is now 100% more dramatic when being caged again.

[Pending Restart] [Magtheridon's Lair] [Magtheridon]: Fixed an issue where damage inflicted by the Manticron Cube to the channeling player would not scale with certain damage modifiers. Manticron Cube damage now respects immunity effects.

[Pending Restart] [Magtheridon's Lair] [Magtheridon]: Players can now move in close proximity to a Manticron Cube while channeling Shadow Grasp, although movement speed is greatly reduced during the channel.
[Pending Restart] [Magtheridon's Lair] [Magtheridon]: Debris now includes an additional area indicator before falling to the ground.
[Pending Restart] [Magtheridon's Lair] [Magtheridon]: Fixed an issue where falling debris would not scale with certain types of damage modifiers.
[Pending Restart] [Magtheridon's Lair] [Magtheridon]: Corrected an issue where the collapsing roof would not scale with certain types of damage modifiers.
[Pending Restart] [Magtheridon's Lair] [Magtheridon]: Magtheridon now appears 100% cooler when collapsing the roof.

[Pending Restart] [Magtheridon's Lair] [Magtheridon]: Magtheridon will no longer delay or cancel passive events when caged or when collapsing the roof. This includes Wrath of the Pitlord stacking, debris, and Abyssal summoning.
[Pending Restart] [Magtheridon's Lair] [Magtheridon]: Fixed an issue where Magtheridon would delay his berserker timer when caged.

[Pending Restart] [Magtheridon's Lair] [Magtheridon]: Corrected an issue where Conflagrate would not scale with certain damage modifiers. Conflagrate damage will now respect immunity effects, although its aura still bypasses them.
[Pending Restart] [Magtheridon's Lair] [Magtheridon]: Blaze, now named Conflagrate, has a less jarring ground visual.
[Pending Restart] [Magtheridon's Lair] [Magtheridon]: Increased damage inflicted by Wrath of the Pitlord by 30%.
[Pending Restart] [Magtheridon's Lair] [Magtheridon]: Blast Nova now persists indefinitely unless interrupted, increasing enemies’ fire damage taken by 5% with each cast until interrupted.

[Pending Restart] [Magtheridon's Lair] [Magtheridon]: Magtheridon will no longer cleave with an auto-attack. When ready to cleave, he will execute it instead of an auto-attack. Cleave now visualizes its effect area.
[Pending Restart] [Magtheridon's Lair] [Magtheridon]: Magtheridon will now hold all other events while channeling Quake or Blast Nova, resuming events when his channeling ends.
[Pending Restart] [Magtheridon's Lair] [Magtheridon]: Magtheridon is now more enthusiastic when attempting to break free from his chains.
[Pending Restart] [Magtheridon's Lair] [Magtheridon]: Increased Magtheridon’s hitbox radius by 200%.
[Pending Restart] [Magtheridon's Lair] [Magtheridon]: Magtheridon now uses his HD model as the default in both SD and HD, correcting various animation errors.

[Pending Restart] [Magtheridon's Lair] [Magtheridon]: Abyssals summoned by Hellfire Channelers and Magtheridon now use an updated model. Abyssals must build up for 4 seconds before they can attack. Abyssals no longer despawn on a timer, and all are now owned by Magtheridon, even when summoned by Hellfire Channelers.

[Pending Restart] [Magtheridon's Lair] [Magtheridon]: Improved caster AI of Hellfire Channelers. Hellfire Channelers will now execute events immediately after completing an active cast, without skipping or canceling events.

0.description: Fixed an issue where some achievements that were not meant to be disabled in the manastorm were not granting their completion i.e. horizontal progression achievements for unlocking gear.

Dark Command from Corla in Blackrock Caverns will now deal half as much damage but lasts twice as long. Additionally, it can be removed and prevented from effects like Tremor Totem and Fear Ward (respectively).
[Pending Restart] - Cursed Pocketwatch of Medivh now scales with 35% of SP from 50% but now deals arcane damage and can critically strike. (Previously it could not).

Uncommon quality gems no longer grant stats until level 60. Rare gems no longer grant stats until 70. Common gems no longer grant stats until level 58. This is to prevent a situation where level scaled gear from TBC can get more power than intended while levelling by slotting in gems when previously at that level no gems were accessible to gear.
